StringListProperty.Name: AdditionalIncludeDirectories
StringListProperty.Description: Specifies one or more directories to add to the include path for HLSL compilation.

StringProperty.Name: ShaderModel
StringProperty.Description: Specifies the shader model version, e.g. 6.6

StringListProperty.Name: VertexEntryPoints
StringListProperty.Description: Semicolon-separated vertex shader entries. Use EntryPoint or output_symbol=EntryPoint.

StringListProperty.Name: PixelEntryPoints
StringListProperty.Description: Semicolon-separated pixel shader entries. Use EntryPoint or output_symbol=EntryPoint.

StringListProperty.Name: GeometryEntryPoints
StringListProperty.Description: Semicolon-separated geometry shader entries. Use EntryPoint or output_symbol=EntryPoint.

StringListProperty.Name: ComputeEntryPoints
StringListProperty.Description: Semicolon-separated compute shader entries. Use EntryPoint or output_symbol=EntryPoint.

StringListProperty.Name: LibraryTargets
StringListProperty.Description: Semicolon-separated library targets. Use output_symbol or output_symbol=lib_6_6.
